title: State store shared definitions
description: Book 1.1.0. The ONE record envelope every kind carries (shared/state-store.xml#envelope): identity, kind, code and writing node, plus at, seq, epoch and hash that N-01 sets at commit. A record on input may omit at and has no seq or epoch; a committed record has seq, at and epoch (committed_envelope). The operation key, the lease reference, preconditions and entity writes are not envelope fields: they ride on the commit request (contracts.schema.json#/$defs/commit_request, shared/contracts.xml#batch). Node schemas $ref #/$defs/envelope (or committed_envelope) and add their body fields. The id form is the UTC-stamp form N-01 owns; see rejected-with-reason.xml#envelope-id-form for the r-prefixed form that was rejected.

id.description: UTC stamp, the status code, five lowercase alphanumerics; unique per writer

at.description: UTC, second precision; assigned by N-01 at commit when absent on input

kind.description: lowercase, dotted where it has parts (lease.granted); a line-op kind such as dispatch or merge is one segment; registered in state-store.xml#record-kinds-registry

code.description: a value of shared/status-codes.xml#codes; N-01 validates against the live code table, this enum is the book's copy

ticket.description: A work order id, or CR-<request id> for a cut request that N-03 admitted from a ticket.request (nodes/N-03/spec.xml#input)

lease_token.description: fencing token from entity counter:lease_token; only grows; an INTEGER everywhere (leases.token, heartbeats.token); the commit request carries it in lease {key, token} (contracts.schema.json#/$defs/lease_ref, shared/contracts.xml#fencing)

idempotency_key.description: the operation key, node/operation/subject/rREVISION (shared/contracts.xml#operation-keys); kept under this name for node schemas that already $ref it; same request hash replays 200, a different hash is 409 idempotency_mismatch

epoch.description: the store epoch the record was committed in (shared/contracts.xml#epoch-cursor); set by N-01 at commit, never trusted on input

schema_version.description: optional marker of the envelope generation; when present it is 2.0.0

by.description: the caller N-01 derived from the peer credential (shared/authority.xml#role-derivation); differs from node when a statement owner's kind is written by another node

seq.description: assigned by N-01 at commit; never on input; strictly increasing, not gapless

recovery_of.description: optional; on a 2xx record, the id of the alerting record it resolves (nodes/N-41/spec.xml)

committed_envelope.description: The envelope as stored and read back: seq, at and epoch are present (N-01 assigns them and hash at commit; hash is required on record.committed, nodes/N-01/record.schema.json#/$defs/record_committed)
